data.title: Century Casinos Posts Record Q2 Revenue Amid Ongoing Losses
data.description:
Claim 55% Off TipRanks

An announcement from Century Casinos ( (CNTY) ) is now available.

Century Casinos on August 7, 2026 reported second-quarter 2026 results showing all-time record Q2 net operating revenue of $152.0 million and Adjusted EBITDAR of $31.7 million, up 1% and 5% respectively from a year earlier, while earnings from operations rose 4% to $17.2 million. Despite these operational gains and an 11% improvement in net loss to $10.9 million, the company remained loss-making, reflecting ongoing cost and regional pressures.

North American operations led the quarter, with the US West segment delivering a 16% revenue increase to $23.4 million and a 93% jump in Adjusted EBITDAR, driven largely by the Nugget’s continued turnaround, while overall six‑month net operating revenue rose 3% and Adjusted EBITDAR climbed 12% versus the first half of 2025. However, underperformance in Poland, partly due to low table hold in June 2026, weighed on results, underscoring that the group’s record revenue and margin gains are still offset by weaker international operations even as management sees early signs of improvement there.

The most recent analyst rating on (CNTY) stock is a Buy
with a $2.50 price target.

see the CNTY Stock Forecast page.

According to Spark, TipRanks’ AI Analyst, CNTY is a Neutral.

The score is held down primarily by weak financial fundamentals—ongoing losses, negative free cash flow, and a strained balance sheet with high leverage and negative equity. Technicals also remain soft with the stock trading below major moving averages. Corporate events are a small offset due to record revenue and improved operating results, but valuation is not supportive given negative earnings and no dividend.

More about Century Casinos

Century Casinos, Inc. is a U.S.-listed gaming company operating casinos and related entertainment properties, with a significant footprint in North America, including its US West segment anchored by the Nugget, and its US Midwest segment in Missouri and Colorado. The company also operates in Poland, where results are more volatile, giving it a mix of mature and developing gaming markets.

The diversified geographic portfolio exposes Century Casinos to differing regional dynamics, with North American properties currently providing the main growth engine while European operations, particularly in Poland, can dampen consolidated performance. Management emphasizes Adjusted EBITDAR as a key performance measure to assess operating trends across its segments.
